page.heading: Settings
page.description: Manage playback and your personal recommendation profile.

playback.heading: Playback
playback.description: Prepare upcoming audio in the browser and control mobile data usage.
playback.qualityHint: Lower quality uses less mobile data and lets the next track buffer faster.
playback.prefetchHint: Each track is a whole file in the phone's memory and uses data.
playback.prefetchAheadHint: Off: only the next track is downloaded ahead. On: several upcoming tracks are kept whole in the browser, so the music keeps going when the phone cuts the network in the background.

flowProfile.heading: Flow Profile
flowProfile.description: Flow uses your listening history to build a personal taste profile. Rebuild after you've added new music or want to refresh recommendations.
flowProfile.coldStartHint: No taste signal yet — Flow is exploring a diverse sample of your library. Like tracks and rebuild to personalise.
flowProfile.emptyHint: No tracks with embeddings found. Analyze your library and try again.

telegram.heading: Telegram
telegram.description: Link your Telegram account to send tracks and releases from Share straight to your chat with the bot.
telegram.openBotHint: Press Start in the chat with the bot. The link works once and expires in 10 minutes.
telegram.connectError: Could not reach the bot. Try again later.
